assessments.reasoning: Condition 3 identifies the protected item as the notice and states the source-distribution trigger without an alteration prerequisite.

challenge.method: Tested deleting the notice from unchanged source, shortening it to an author credit in modified source, and applying condition 3 to an assumed binary-only shipment.
challenge.results: Deletion and shortening engage the two express prohibitions. A credit in product documentation cannot substitute for preservation in source. A binary-only hypothesis supplies no source distribution to trigger condition 3 and establishes no broader compliance outcome.

limitations: The finding assumes a source distribution. It leaves mixed-package classification, other notices and rights to redistribute license wording itself outside scope.
reasoning: Condition 3 protects the notice against both removal and alteration in any covered source distribution. Its wording reaches unchanged source as well as modified source.
